simple.meaning: שְׁבוּעָה (shᵉbûwʻâh) appears 30 times in the Hebrew Scriptures and is introduced in connection with flocks and in connection with priesthood.
simple.biblicalBackground: The first appearances are in Genesis, Exodus, Leviticus, Numbers, Deuteronomy, and 16 more, beginning at Genesis 24:8. BibleIQ detects the main surrounding context as family, family line, priesthood, land.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to שְׁבוּעָה (H7621) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: People in Scripture are understood by their place in the story. BibleIQ follows שְׁבוּעָה through the actual verses so the reader sees the person in context instead of as an isolated dictionary entry.

and her husband heard it, and held his peace at her and didn’t disallow her, then all her vows shall stand, and every pledge with which she bound her soul shall stand.

The children of Israel said, “Who is there among all the tribes of Israel who didn’t come up in the assembly to Yahweh?” For they had made a great oath concerning him who didn’t come up to Yahweh to Mizpah, saying, “He shall surely be put to death.”
When the people had come to the forest, behold, honey was dripping, but no one put his hand to his mouth; for the people feared the oath.
But the king spared Mephibosheth, the son of Jonathan the son of Saul, because of Yahweh’s oath that was between them, between David and Jonathan the son of Saul.
Why then have you not kept the oath of Yahweh, and the commandment that I have instructed you with?”

All Judah rejoiced at the oath, for they had sworn with all their heart, and sought him with their whole desire; and he was found by them. Then Yahweh gave them rest all around.
For there were many in Judah sworn to him, because he was the son-in-law of Shecaniah the son of Arah; and his son Jehohanan had taken the daughter of Meshullam the son of Berechiah as wife.

definitions.short: properly, something sworn , i.e. an oath
definitions.full: H7621. shebuah שְׁבֻעָה שְׁבוּעָה, noun feminine ( Josh 2:17 read הַזּה Albr ZAW xvi(1896), 116 ) oath, curse ; — absolute ׳שְׁבוּ 9:20 +, ׳שְׁבֻ Gen 26:3 +; construct שְׁבֻעַת Exod 22:10 +; suffix שְׁבֻעָתִי Gen 24:8 etc.; plural שְׁבֻעוֺת absolute Ezek 21:28 , construct Hab 3:9 ; [ Jer 5:24 ; Ezek 45:21 see שָׁבוּעַ ]; — oath [as accusative of congnate meaning with verb with הִשָּׁבַע etc. Num 30:3 + (in rel.cl.) 5t.]: 1 of man: a. attesting innocence Exod 22:10 (E), friendship 2Sam 21:7 , promise 1Kin 2:43 (after שָׁמַר keep ; all י ׳שְׁבֻעַת oath to to ( ׳י ); innocence also Num 5:21 a; friendship Neh 6:18 ( ׳בַּעֲלֵישׁ לוֺ ), promise Lev 5:4 ; of vow (|| נדר ) Num 30:3 ; 30:11 ; 30:14 ( אִסָּר שְׁבֻעַת ), Josh 9:20 (all P), Neh 10:30 (|| אָלָה ), Eccl 9:2 , of covenant with ׳י 2Chr 15:15 , אֱלֹהִים שְׁבוּעַת Eccl 8:2 (probably of oath of allegiance to king), שֶׁקֶר שְׁבֻעַת Zech 8:17 ; of threat Judg 21:5 ; 1Sam 14:26 ( י ׳שְׁבֻעַת ᵐ5 ); keep, discharge the oath is הַשּׁ ׳הֵקִים Gen 26:3 (J), Jer 11:5 ; מִשׁ ׳נָקָה be free, exempt from an oath Gen 24:8 (J), compare Josh 2:17 , 20 . b. = curse , Isa 65:15 and (|| אָלָה ) Num 5:21 (P), Dan 9:11 . 2 oath of ׳י , in promise, Deut 7:8 ( שָׁמַר in rel. clause), || covenant ( בְּרִית ), לְיִצְחָק שְׁבוּעַתוֺ Psa 105:9 = 1Chr 16:16 . — מַטּוֺת שְׁבֻעוֺת Hab 3:9 very dubious: AV oaths of the tribes; oaths, rods of the word, Hi-St; sworn (passive participle שְׁבַע ) were the rods ( = chastisements) of (thy) word, Ges Hi RVm; heptads of spears Ew, compare Da; text probably corrupt, Now proposes (אַשְׁמָּֽתְךָׅ שִׂבַּעְתָּ thou hast sated with shafts thy quiver ; Marti (after ᵐ5 Manuscripts ) thy bow was satiated with shafts ; GASm thou gluttest (?) thy shafts . — Ezek 21:28 see √.
